title: Toward practical lithium metal batteries via a solvation structure regulation strategy in in situ polymerized fluorinated gel polymer electrolytes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,9512-9523
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE03662C, Paper
Yunpei Lu, Yuezheng Liu, Shichao Zhang, Yong Wu, Hao Cheng, Yingying Lu
Backbone –CF3 groups non-coordinatively reshape Li+ solvation in a gel polymer electrolyte (GPE), balancing interfacial stability and ion transport toward practical lithium metal batteries under elevated-voltage operation.
